sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName, sumIf(s.SalesAmount, s.PromotionKey != 1) AS PromotionSalesAmount, sumIf(s.SalesAmount, s.PromotionKey = 1) AS FullPriceSalesAmount, sumIf(s.SalesAmount, s.PromotionKey != 1) - sumIf(s.SalesAmount, s.PromotionKey = 1) AS IncrementalRevenue, sumIf(s.DiscountAmount, s.PromotionKey != 1) AS TotalDiscountAmount FROM retail.FactSales AS s INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName ORDER BY IncrementalRevenue DESC
